correctness.rationale: For the 4-site open XX Lindblad chain with coherent hopping normalised J=1, uniform tilt U and boundary coupling G, the source reconstructs the exact stationary Pauli-string 16-equation reduction giving R=1/j=(16+G²+6Gg)/(16G)+z P/(8Q), z=U² and positive Q. I independently re-expanded the displayed P,Q with exact symbolic polynomial algebra. W1=P Q_g-P_g Q contains precisely 85 positive nonzero integer monomials and W2=P_gg Q²-P Q_gg Q-2 P_g Q_g Q+2P(Q_g)² exactly 224, all positive (smallest coeffs 1 and 2), so R_g has strictly increasing derivative for U>0. Exact expansion verifies R_g(0)=-G² Φ_G(z)/(8Q0²). Every nonconstant z coefficient of Φ is positive and its constant is negative, giving unique positive threshold z_c. With R_g→3/8 as g→∞, strict convexity yields the complete global optimizer trichotomy including equality at U_c. Dominant balance gives U_c~√(3/140)G as G→0, U_c~8√3/G as G→∞, and at G=1 independent unique-root evaluation U_c=0.148539003114375. At U=0 resistance is linear, and no strict convexity is claimed there. The finite coefficient certificate alone does not validate the quantum 16-equation premise; the published model/closure and source construction were also inspected.
